rules.R1: matched_budget_controlled=no→downgrade(无匹配预算对照,拿更大evaluation-call预算冒充改进)
rules.R2: shared_start_artifacts=no→downgrade(无identical starting agents/artifacts对照,拿更强初始冒充improver gain)
rules.R3: evaluator_fixed_independent=no→flag(real evaluator未固定/与improver未分离/无held-out gain,自评当独立)
rules.R4: improver_gain_isolated=no→flag(无frozen-vs-GVO cumulative gains隔离,product增益冒充process增益)
rules.R5: 任一partial→flag(受控对照边界披露覆盖不全,待核)
rules.R6: 全yes→ok(只判声明自洽,不承诺RSI真实有效;self-reported折1)

forensic_spec.dimensions: 四维逐字锚点取自S02摘要+§3 GVO+§4.4 RQ3+Γ评估器定义段;disclose必中红旗零误中
